# AgentToolsAtlas

> A research-linked directory of protocols, infrastructure, memory, security, trust, and discovery tools for AI agents.
> Snapshot: October 14, 2026. Entries are research-linked, not live-verified.
> Machine-readable catalog: https://agent-tools-listing.vercel.app/catalog.json

## Catalog

### Payments

- [x402](https://pondero.ai/agents/guides/x402-vs-acp-vs-ap2-agent-payment-protocols-october-2026/): HTTP-native fixed-price settlement for machine requests. A client receives 402 terms, pays in USDC through a facilitator, then retries with proof.
- [Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)](https://www.inriver.com/resources/ap2-mpp-x402-payment-protocols-agent-commerce/): A mandate layer for proving that a human authorized an agent purchase envelope, using signed intent, cart and payment artifacts.
- [Machine Payments Protocol (MPP)](https://www.inriver.com/resources/ap2-mpp-x402-payment-protocols-agent-commerce/): Stripe and Tempo’s machine-to-machine settlement model, with charge and session intents and backward compatibility with x402.
- [AgentCore Payments](https://github.com/tatelyman/sample-agentcore-cloudfront-x402-payments): AWS preview combining a managed wallet, session limits and payment audit for AWS agents, with Coinbase CDP or Stripe Privy integrations.
- [Pinout](https://github.com/hitakshia/pinout): An implementation reference exploring the gap between one-shot x402 charges and metered or session-style billing.

### Trust

- [ERC-8004](https://blockeden.xyz/blog/2026/02/11/nillion-blacklight-ai-agent-verification/): On-chain identity, reputation and validation registries for agents. The standard deliberately leaves score calculation to outside systems.
- [Vouch](https://dev.to/vouch/x402-proves-payment-it-doesnt-prove-trust-so-we-built-vouch-2fen): A build-in-public trust layer producing payer and payee scores plus ALLOW, WARN or BLOCK decisions for x402 interactions.
- [AgentCredit](https://github.com/lazykid64/agentcredit/blob/HEAD/README.md): An experimental reputation-priced x402 project using zero-knowledge proofs on Base Sepolia.

### Control

- [SpendVeto](https://github.com/revanthrajeev/spendveto): Deterministic spend controls with caps, budgets, approvals, kill switch, idempotency replay, dry-run and time-boxed grants.
- [Virtuals Programmable Wallets](https://cryptobriefing.com/virtuals-protocol-agent-wallet-prompt-injection/): Server-side wallet policy controls for agents, including restrictive presets such as DENY_ALL and ACP_ONLY.

### Discovery

- [MCP Registry / Harbor](https://github.com/lbesecker195/mcp_registry): Indexes MCP servers so builders can discover remote tools. The research cites roughly 9,652 servers in the official registry and 31,486 indexed by Harbor in 2026.
- [Agent2Agent (A2A)](https://dev.to/jeff_pdc/a2a-vs-mcp-in-2026-when-agents-should-talk-to-agents-instead-of-calling-tools-4b9g): A delegation protocol using Agent Cards and a task lifecycle for agents that need to coordinate across organizations.
- [FetchGate Bazaar Audit](https://github.com/roblouw2nd/fetchgate/blob/HEAD/content/x402-bazaar-october-2026.md): A public crawl and audit of x402 Bazaar listings, focused on availability, price, payer counts and listing churn.

### Memory

- [Mem0](https://yourstory.com/ai-story/san-francisco-startup-mem0-raises-24-million-long-term-ai-memory-power): A prominent long-term memory layer for agents, with a hosted API and integration into the broader agent ecosystem.
- [Zep / Graphiti](https://valueaddvc.com/blog/the-ai-memory-problem-how-startups-are-solving-for-persistent-context): Temporal knowledge-graph memory for agents, aimed at retaining and retrieving changing context over time.
- [Letta](https://particula.tech/blog/agent-memory-frameworks-tested-mem0-zep-letta-cognee-2026): An OS-inspired agent memory approach with layered memory and git-backed context repositories described in the 2026 research.

### Observability

- [Langfuse](https://latitude.so/blog/best-ai-agent-observability-tools-2026-comparison): Open-source tracing and evaluation infrastructure in the crowded agent observability category.
- [Braintrust](https://latitude.so/blog/best-ai-agent-observability-tools-2026-comparison): Evaluation-driven tooling for testing and monitoring AI systems, included in the research’s observability comparison set.

### Sandbox

- [Daytona](https://github.com/imtiazrayhan/agentscamp/blob/HEAD/src/content/tools/daytona.md): Managed execution infrastructure for running agent-generated code in isolated environments.
- [E2B](https://bex.co/blog/2026/10/02/e2b-vs-modal-vs-daytona-agent-sandboxes-vs-app-deploys): Cloud sandboxes designed for AI-generated code and computer-use workloads.

### Security

- [Manifest by Manifold](https://siliconangle.com/2026/05/12/manifold-scores-7700-mcp-servers-manifest-expansion-aimed-agent-security-teams/): MCP security scoring and asset inventory; the cited research reported 7,700 servers scored and 206,000 assets indexed.
- [Arcade](https://github.com/druce/governance/blob/HEAD/wiki/vendors/arcade.md): Agent tool authorization infrastructure included in the research’s funded enterprise security set.

### Identity

- [Aembit](https://techstartups.com/2026/10/06/aembit-extends-access-controls-to-personal-ai-agents/): Access-control infrastructure extending workload identity concepts to personal AI agents.
- [Okta for AI Agents](https://www.forrester.com/blogs/oktane-2026-recap-okta-announces-a-unified-iam-control-plane-with-agent-governance-and-identity-details-remaining-unclear/): Enterprise identity and governance controls for agents inside Okta’s broader identity control plane.

## Notes

- Before wiring any entry into a production agent, verify its current response contract, pricing, and repeatability. This catalog is a dated snapshot, not an uptime monitor.
